race.comment: PLAYING SOLO (9) ended last campaign with a good run at Pinjarra and has trialled well coming into this campaign. He's been gelded this time in work and CJP hops on board for the first time. Maps to get every chance and can resume on a winning note. NIGHT BROKER (10) had trialled well leading into his debut, but fell out the back and pulled up with a few issues. He jumped a $2.70 fave there and the tongue tie is applied this time. Pike sticks, so expect a much better run this time around. KUTE AS KAN BE (12) faded first-up but was much better last time, missing in a photo finish at Northam. Tsang remains in the irons, meaning she'll carry no weight. Can get up front and make every post a winner. ROLLWITHTHEPUNCHES (11) improved nicely last start and getting out in trip again looks a good move. Can feature. MERCHANT TRADER (6) won a trial impressively coming into this and can't be discounted.
